title.bi: Footprints of Light 光之踪迹 · Genesis 1–5 创世记 1—5 章

text.bibleNotice: The Holy Bible, Berean Standard Bible, BSB is produced in cooperation with Bible Hub, Discovery Bible, unfoldingWord, Bible Aquifer, OpenBible.com, and the Berean Bible Translation Committee. This text of God's Word has been dedicated to the public domain.
text.cuvNotice: 中文经文引自和合本（新标点和合本，神版）。

line1.en: You witnessed the seven days of creation, walked into the garden in the east, went out with them to the east of Eden, saw what happened between two brothers, and walked the road of ten generations, from Adam to Noah.
line1.zh: 你见证了创造的七日，走进了东方的园子，陪他们走到了伊甸的东边，看见了两兄弟之间发生的事，又走过了从亚当到挪亚的十代人。

line2.en: The next chapter, “The Ark” (Genesis 6–8), is being made by all of us together.
line2.zh: 下一章《方舟》（创世记 6—8 章），正在由我们一起制作。

backToMap.en: Back to the Map of Light

sub.zh: 创世记 1—5 章 · 起初

text.en: Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters, but Your footprints were not to be found.
text.zh: 你的道在海中；你的路在大水中；你的脚踪无人知道。

helpDesk.en: Computer: [[W A S D]] or arrow keys to move, hold [[Shift]] to run, [[Space]] to jump (hold it in the air to glide), drag the mouse to look around, scroll to zoom, [[B]] opens the journal, [[L]] switches language.
helpDesk.zh: 电脑：[[W A S D]] 或方向键移动，按住 [[Shift]] 奔跑，[[空格]] 跳跃（在空中按住滑翔），拖动鼠标看四周，滚轮拉近拉远，[[B]] 打开图鉴，[[L]] 切换语言。

helpPhone.en: Phone: use the joystick at the bottom left to move, drag the right half of the screen to look around, and tap the button at the bottom right to jump. Headphones recommended.
helpPhone.zh: 手机：左下角摇杆移动，右半边屏幕拖动看四周，右下角按钮跳跃。建议戴上耳机。
